uncited: It builds on [1D Transfer Function Generation and Sampling](2689-1d-transfer-function-generation-and-sampling.md) by implementing the actual lookup and sampling of the generated transfer function.
**Determine Data Bounds:** Identify $v_{min}$ and $v_{max}$ for the dataset.

**Compute Opacity (Optional/Implicit):** Normalize the scaled value to lie between 0 (transparent) and 1 (opaque) if opacity is not directly stored in the LUT or if a separate opacity function is used.
The overall complexity is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of voxels.
